rows.proof: The town's own arithmetic. The 183 leaf rows sum to $37,626,083.44 in APPROPRIATED FORWARD against the printed GRAND TOTAL $37,626,445.44, out by exactly $362.00, and the printed legend `fwd - forward from FY 2016 $637,981.43` is out by the same $362.00 against the 26 fwd lines the page prints. Page 25: `Police Fire Medical Expenses` prints $5,000.00 APPROPRIATED FORWARD and $5,362.00 TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, and its unlabelled subtotal row immediately below prints $5,362.00 in BOTH columns. The $362.00 carry-forward line those three figures require IS NOT PRINTED: the render at 300dpi shows the marker line above that row blank where every other group carries fwd/srt/rft. srt and rft both close to the cent, so this is one missing fwd line in the published document, not a reading failure.

`TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2017`, PDF pages 24-28 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PAGE CARRIES ITS OWN TEXT LAYER -- pdfplumber returns 317/284/276/278/306 words on pages 24/25/26/27/28 and the pages hold no image at all -- so this is read, not recognised, and the OCR reading of these pages is discarded rather than reconciled. THE PRINTED HEADER, read off every one of the five pages and identical on each, is two lines: `PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED | TOTAL FUNDS | TOTAL | TOTAL | BALANCE TO` over `FORWARD | AVAILABLE | EXPENDED | ENCUMBERED | REVENUE`. The five money columns are right-aligned and their right edges cluster at x1 306-313, 375-383, 433-442, 485-488 and 533-539 with no overlap; all 798 money tokens on the five pages land in a column and none is unplaced. 183 leaf rows (line items plus the 36 fwd/srt/rft carry-forward lines, which are lines OF the column -- the heading is APPROPRIATED *FORWARD* and every department subtotal includes them). FOUR INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES CLOSE TO THE CENT: (1) the printed GRAND TOTAL on page 28, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE $37,626,445.44; (2) TOTAL EXPENDED $36,739,086.52; (3) TOTAL ENCUMBERED $675,368.25; (4) 90 of 90 rows that print BALANCE TO REVENUE satisfy available - expended - encumbered = balance, the GRAND TOTAL row among them. The page's own footer legend gives two more: `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $38,689.26` is the sum of the 9 lines marked srt, exactly, and `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer $29,993.00` is the single line so marked. THE ONE COLUMN THAT DOES NOT CLOSE IS ATTESTED, NOT TOLERATED: APPROPRIATED FORWARD sums to $37,626,083.44 against a printed $37,626,445.44, short exactly $362.00, and the legend `fwd - forward from FY 2016 $637,981.43` is short by the SAME $362.00 against the 26 fwd lines printed. Both point at one block, Police Fire Medical Expenses on page 25: the item row prints $5,000.00 APPROPRIATED FORWARD and $5,362.00 TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, and its own subtotal row prints $5,362.00 in BOTH columns -- so the document requires a $362.00 carry-forward line that it does not print. Confirmed by eye on a 300dpi render of pages 25 at y 460-580: the line above `Police Fire Medical Expenses`, where every other group prints its fwd/srt marker, is BLANK. THIS IS THE TOWN'S OWN ARITHMETIC DISAGREEING WITH ITSELF, not a misread, and an extractor that made it close would be wrong.

rows.proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2017`, PDF page 34 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 1 word and the page holds one image at 223 dpi -- AND IT IS LANDSCAPE, so it was rotated into its own one-page PDF first and the crops aimed at coordinates that mean what they look like. THE PRINTED HEADER, verbatim, column by column: `ART #/YR | PURPOSE | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/ TRANSFERRED | BALANCE`, with a narrow unheaded column between APPROPRIATED FORWARD and EXPENDED that carries the marker `fwd`. The page's own legend, at its foot: `fwd - forward from FY 16`, `ATM - Annual Town Meeting`, `STM - Special Town Meeting`. Projects are grouped under italic programme headings FY14 / FY15 / FY16 / FY17 Capital Program; the article and year in ART #/YR is what a resident uses to find the vote that authorised the project. 36 projects. ALL THREE COLUMNS TIE TO THE PRINTED GRAND TOTAL TO THE CENT: APPROPRIATED FORWARD $12,169,172.27, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED $3,583,457.59, BALANCE $8,585,714.68 -- and the Grand Total row's own identity closes, 12,169,172.27 - 3,583,457.59 = 8,585,714.68. All 36 project rows satisfy APPROPRIATED FORWARD minus EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED equals BALANCE, to the cent. A single wrong digit anywhere would break one of those and the column it sits in. ONE PROJECT PRINTS ITS COLUMN ON TWO LINES AND THE PAGE'S OWN ARITHMETIC ESTABLISHES THAT IT IS ONE ROW. `Development of Cemeteries` (art 08/02 ATM) prints $35,000.00 on the line above and ($9,210.37) marked `fwd` on its own line, against one EXPENDED figure $26,402.59 and one BALANCE ($612.96): 35,000.00 - 9,210.37 - 26,402.59 = -612.96 exactly, which is what says the two lines are the appropriation and its carry-forward rather than two projects. The merged figure $25,789.63 is recorded as that project's APPROPRIATED FORWARD and BOTH PRINTED LINES ARE KEPT VERBATIM BESIDE IT as separate rows, so nothing is quoted that the page does not print. A NEGATIVE IN THE EXPENDED COLUMN IS PRINTED IN PARENTHESES and means a credit back to the project -- five rows carry one, and each of them closes. A blank EXPENDED cell is left blank by the page and is not recorded as a zero.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / TRUST FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR 2017 SUMMARY`, `Page 1 of 3`, PDF page 37 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM, COLUMN BY COLUMN: `ACCOUNT NUMBER` | `FUND NAME` | `FY 2017 BEGINNING PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 BEGINNING EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 CONTRIBUTE TO PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 NET EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 ENDING CASH VALUE` | `FY 2017 UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `FY 2017 ENDING MARKET VALUE`. Every column heading was READ off the page and written down; none is inferred. THE `ACCOUNT NUMBER` COLUMN IS PRINTED AND EMPTY on every row of this page. WHAT THE PAGE HOLDS, counted off the page rather than off any dataset: THREE groups and TWENTY-TWO funds -- `CEMETERY FUNDS` (3), `CONSERVATION FUNDS` (5), `LIBRARY FUNDS` (14) -- each group closed by its own `SUBTOTALS` line. It is page 1 of 3; the scholarship, miscellaneous and stabilization groups and the statement's `GRAND TOTALS` are on page 38. HOW IT WAS READ: the page is a SINGLE EMBEDDED SCAN -- pdfplumber returns one word (the folio) and one image -- so the scanner's own pixels were taken straight off the PDF with pypdf, rotated upright and cropped into two column blocks, each with the fund-name strip pasted beside it so a figure stays attached to the row it is printed on. Neither render script was used, so neither could clip it. WHAT PROVES IT, three ways, AND EVERY ONE CLOSES TO THE CENT WITH NO TOLERANCE AT ALL. (1) TWENTY-TWO ROW IDENTITIES: beginning principal + beginning earnings + contribute to principal + net earnings + disburse from principal + transfers of earnings = `ENDING CASH VALUE`, on all 22 funds, exactly. (2) TWENTY-SEVEN COLUMN SUBTOTALS: nine columns against each of the three printed `SUBTOTALS` lines, all 27 exactly. (3) THE STATEMENT'S OWN `GRAND TOTALS`, WHICH ARE PRINTED ON PAGE 38 AND FOOT ACROSS BOTH PAGES: this page's three subtotals plus page 38's three add to all nine printed grand totals to the cent -- $2,273,700.80 / $187,191.63 / $112,634.17 / $31,649.20 / ($19,335.24) / ($18,314.75) / $2,567,525.81 / ($23,347.80) / $2,608,445.39. That cross-page reconciliation is `fy2017-p37-trust-grand-totals.csv` and it is what makes the `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` and `ENDING MARKET VALUE` columns checkable at all. *** THIS PAGE STATES NO IDENTITY LINKING `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` TO `ENDING MARKET VALUE`, AND THE ONE THE ADJACENT YEARS STATE DOES NOT HOLD HERE. *** FY2018 page 44 and FY2021 page 40 both close on `ending cash value + unrealized gain/loss = ending market value`. On this page that identity fails on every row: PERPETUAL CARE BEQUEST is $187,455.81 cash and ($1,847.76) unrealized against an ending market value of $190,443.36, which is $4,835.31 the other way. What the figures DO show is that `ENDING MARKET VALUE` divided by `ENDING CASH VALUE` is 1.015937 on every one of the 22 funds and on all three subtotal lines, and that `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` divided by `ENDING CASH VALUE` is -0.009857 on every one -- two constant pro-rata allocations across the whole page. THAT IS A REGULARITY, NOT AN IDENTITY THE PAGE STATES, so it is NOT used as a check here: offering it as one would be a hypothesis dressed as a proof. WHAT THE COLUMN MEANS IS NOT ESTABLISHED -- cumulative unrealized gain, the year's change in it, and a custodian's allocation all fit the same figures -- and nothing on the page says. The two columns are instead proved by their subtotals and by the cross-page grand totals, which is what rule 7b's advice amounts to for a column no row identity touches. ONE FUND NAME IS CLIPPED BY THE DOCUMENT ITSELF. The last library row prints `ANNIE & ARTHUR BILLINGS CULTURAL TR` and the name runs into the `BEGINNING PRINCIPAL` column and is cut off there by the page, not by the reading. It is transcribed as the page prints it; the full name is not recoverable from this page. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. A trust fund balance is not money the town may spend: the purpose, the restriction and the donor's terms are nowhere on this page, and nothing here says which of these funds is expendable. `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` and `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` record that money moved; they do not say where it went or what it bought. And the ACCOUNT NUMBER column being empty means these funds cannot be joined to the general ledger from this page.
